name: Employer-Sponsored Work Residence Visa (Relación de Dependencia)

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals with an employment contract with a public or private Ecuadorian employer, under a dependent-employment relationship (relación de dependencia).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Employment contract or personnel action; employer's work-contract registration certificate from the Ministry of Labour; employer's tax/social-security compliance certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: Employment contract or personnel action issued by the public or private employer, with a work-contract registration certificate from the Ministry of Labour.
The employer must hold a compliance certificate confirming no outstanding obligations with the Internal Revenue Service (SRI), Social Security Institute (IESS), and the Superintendence of Companies.

evidence_required.document: Ministry of Labour work-contract registration certificate
Employer's SRI/IESS/Superintendence of Companies compliance certificate

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Employer-sponsored work residence visa: employment contract and Ministry of Labour registration requirement, employer SRI/IESS/Superintendence of Companies compliance certificate, 2-year duration

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the visa is tied to the specific registered employment relationship. pr_after_months (21) reflects Ecuador's general 21-continuous-months-of-temporary-residence route to permanent residence (see ec_permanent_residence.json), not a work-specific fast-track.
